apps.name: Vela
apps.subtitle: Maps, navigation and offline regions
apps.localizedDescription:
Vela is a privacy-minded maps app: search, place details, routes, guided navigation, saved places and offline regions.

Development build distributed unsigned for AltStore, SideStore or Sideloadly. The app and its navigation Live Activity extension must be signed together.

privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Vela keeps guiding you during navigation while the screen is off or another app is open.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Vela shows where you are on the map and guides you along your route.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Vela listens to what you say when you tap the microphone for voice search. Nothing is recorded until you tap it.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Vela uses on-device speech recognition to turn your voice into a search or a destination.
